run_habitat_sim_demo: run a habitat-sim demo with configurable scene resolution and sensor settings
run_demo_with_semantic_sensor: run the habitat-sim example with the semantic sensor enabled for scene analysis
run_demo_with_depth_sensor: run the habitat-sim example with the depth sensor enabled for depth perception
run_demo_compute_shortest_path: run the habitat-sim example and compute the shortest path in the scene
run_demo_with_physics: run the habitat-sim example with physics simulation enabled using a config file
